parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1434 | 2.5 | 2.5
2 | 1879 | 5.42 | 7.92
3 | 318 | 18 | 25.9
4 | 3488 | 24.3 | 50.2
5 | 542 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: > 50.2 m (primary deep aquifer; secondary shallow zone at 7.92 – 25.9 m)
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of 60–70 m to fully penetrate and exploit the productive fifth layer for optimum yield and water quality. Ensure proper casing across the upper resistive formations and install appropriate screen and gravel pack within the water-bearing horizon.
